name: system-prompt-optimization-dataset
description: Dataset for comparing system prompt effectiveness in code generation tasks

input.prompt: Implement a binary search function that takes a sorted array and a target value, returning the index of the target or -1 if not found.
Create a singly linked list class with methods to add elements at the beginning, add at the end, remove by value, and display all elements.

expected.functionality: Singly linked list with basic operations

input.prompt: Create an asynchronous data processor that fetches data from multiple URLs concurrently, processes each response, and returns a summary of results with error handling.

expected.functionality: Async data processing with concurrent requests and error handling

input.prompt: Implement a memoized Fibonacci function that efficiently calculates large Fibonacci numbers by caching previously computed results.

expected.functionality: Memoized Fibonacci calculation with performance optimization

input.prompt: Create an EventEmitter class that allows subscribing to events, emitting events with data, and unsubscribing from events. Include support for one-time listeners.

expected.functionality: Event emitter with subscription, emission, and unsubscription capabilities
